comment: A simulation's step can be a pixel function. The fixture module under tests/fixtures/life-pixel/modules registers Life written as a pixel function of eighteen lines as the rule `life_pixels`. Three short strokes are painted with a small brush, the rule goes on the layer through `simulation`, and a hundred steps are run. The shot at step 100 is the record `check_shots.py` reads, since Life is the same picture on every run from the same strokes.
